subject: [PATCH v5 2/7] mm/page_counter: report the number of pages charged

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch adds an optional parameter to the page_counter_try_charge function, which returns the number of pages actually charged to the hierarchy when successful. This change is made to accommodate a future update in the series where stock can be pushed down from the memcg level to the page_counter level, potentially changing how charges are accounted for. The new parameter is added to all callsites and is used by only one user (try_charge_memcg) to track the hierarchy size growth.

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt
reviews.summary: Reviewer Shakeel Butt noted that the terms 'growing the hierarchy size' and 'hierarchy size growth' are unclear, but found the code to be otherwise correct.
reviews.raw_body:
The terminology of "growing the hierarchy size" and "hierarchy size growth" is
confusing.

The code looks fine.

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch adds an optional parameter to the page_counter_try_charge function, which returns the number of pages actually charged to the hierarchy when successful. This change is necessary because in some cases, a charge can be successful without growing the hierarchy size. The new parameter is used by only one caller, try_charge_memcg, and is not intended to introduce any functional changes.
